tools.Name: GPUStack
tools.Description: A GPU cluster manager for high-performance AI model serving (vLLM, SGLang) and on-demand GPU instance provisioning.
tools.Use_Case: Managing GPU clusters across multiple environments (on-premises, K8s, cloud) and deploying new AI models on release day.

tools.Name: TradingAgents
tools.Description: A multi-agent LLM-powered financial trading framework that simulates a real-world trading firm.
tools.Use_Case: Automated market analysis, debate, and trading strategy formulation using specialized agents like sentiment and technical analysts.

tools.Name: Speech To Speech
tools.Description: A low-latency, modular voice-agent pipeline (VAD -> STT -> LLM -> TTS) supporting fully local and open-source models.
tools.Use_Case: Building production-grade voice agents that support real-time interactions with low latency.
